scope: AI close reading of four pinned Turkish Wikisource development texts, not an independent holdout, not human editorial review

observations.location: Opening stable routine and transition to the narrator alone in the stable
observations.finding: Habitual imperfective verbs establish repeated childhood activity, then bounded past events initiate the incident. Collapsing the opening into completed events changes scene time.

observations.location: Father's questioning of Hasan and later confession to Pervin
observations.finding: Reiterated denial, short replies and interrupted speech are character action and tension; repetition removal or completing an unfinished utterance can alter the plot.

observations.location: Opening landscape, unnamed old man, followed by captivity backstory; recognition sequence on ship
observations.finding: Information about identity and relationship is deliberately staged. Moving all biographical facts into the opening spoils the recognition; the reader's knowledge and chronological event order are separate.

observations.location: Opening personal encounter, digression on photographic representation, then remembered encounter and visual impressions
observations.finding: The apparent digression establishes why the narrator's direct perception differs from expectation. Reducing it to an unrelated tangent or reordering it after the encounter removes the essay's argumentative bridge.

observations.location: Descriptions after the narrator's expectations are overturned
observations.finding: Visual imagery, expressive metaphors and evaluative fragments belong to an individual literary perspective, not measurable documentary claims; do not manufacture an objective fact or flatten the comparison.

observations.location: Opening coordinated subjects spread over multiple lines and recurrence of imagined place toward the closing lines
observations.finding: Line breaks delay syntactic completion; repetition changes emphasis and connects opening to closing. Treat the poem as a whole, not a series of malformed prose sentences.

observations.location: Transcription displays irregular spacing within words
observations.finding: The rendered historical transcription may contain digitization or typography defects. No spelling or original-edition claim is made; verify a scanned edition before altering the transcription.
